pages.text: Begin industrial Draconium work with HV Control Matrices and the relevant GregTech processing. Build a reserve of the basic materials before attempting a large fusion setup.$(br2)At EV, prepare the Fusion Crafting Core and Basic Crafting Injectors. Arrange the workshop, connect suitable FE power and check the entire recipe before starting.
Fusion recipes can require substantial stored energy. Confirm the injector tier, ingredient arrangement, catalyst and total energy together.
